package.name: mu_path_planner
package.description:
Modal mu-calculus path planner for epistemic multi-robot navigation.
Computes backward reachability over the occupancy graph using least fixed-point iteration:
μZ.(at_goal ∨ (¬obstacle ∧ ⟨move⟩Z))
When require_epistemic_goal is set, lifts the goal to:
μZ.(K_i(at_goal) ∨ (¬obstacle ∧ ⟨move⟩Z ∨ ⟨sense⟩Z))
The planner is deliberately decoupled from the epistemic world manager: it receives a snapshot of the current Kripke model on /epistemic/state and publishes a Nav2-compatible path on /mu_planner/path, together with the poses a sensing action has to be taken from on /mu_planner/sensing.
The snapshot format, and how a zone name in a query becomes a set of cells, are documented in include/mu_path_planner/epistemic_state.hpp.
